Breaking my Strava silence now that it’s all over (had to lock in with school rq 😭). Obligatory sentimental post incoming:

I’m very happy I didn’t quit after cross, and for the rest of my life, I’ll be really proud that I decided to run an extra year and saw it through to the very end. I’ve learned and grown so much, and I just feel so grateful for the lady dons that kept me going week after week. Pretty pleased with the indoor and outdoor seasons considering all the health issues I had in the fall and not running over winter break 💀. Found some consistency in January and never missed a workout since then. Got a nice college PB in the 800 and had probably the most fun racing I’ve had in my whole career. Ended it all in LA with my family and high school coach watching who have all never seen me race in college and came away with a nice little win. A fairytale ending in my book tbh. This sport never ceases to amaze me ❤️.  

Finally done with college running after 5 incredible years with people and memories to last a lifetime. My cup is filled, now time for some narp activities 🤗.
